facts.fact: IGAD, under World Bank/IDA-financed FSRP-AF, sought a consultant in March 2026 to monitor and forecast crop conditions across the IGAD region using satellite-derived NDVI, VCI and soil moisture, feeding ICPAC's regional agricultural early warning dashboards (regional scope, not Djibouti-specific).
facts.system: ICPAC regional agricultural early warning systems and dashboards
